svg.title: Kuroshio published filtered width curve readings
svg.desc: 192 month-midpoint plot samples of a half-year-filtered regional width curve, not raw monthly means. Approximate values span 190–225 km; the separate five-kilometre graphical allowance is not source uncertainty or annual extrema. A complete sixteen-by-twelve table and source links accompany these readings.
